title: Island Hop Tampa Bay Private Boat Excursion
includes: Party Boat private to your group with Bluetooth music, cooler, and water
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Welcome aboard Staying Afloat Party Boat Tampa for an island hopping extravaganza you'll never forget! Our private boat adventure in Tampa Bay is all about fun, sun, and making unforgettable memories. Cruise through the sparkling waters, soak up the Florida sun, and explore the hidden gems of the Bay's islands. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just looking for a day of tropical escape, our boat ride offers the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement. Join us for a day of island bliss, with music and great company. Each boat holds up to 12 passengers and stop at beaches, bars, and restaurants along your tour; feel free to customize it however you like. Guests are welcome to BYOB drinks+food. Your private boat odyssey awaits, come and make a splash with us! 
THIS IS NOT THE FULL PRICE: Due to US Coast Guard bareboat laws, you are required to select and pay the Captain directly the day of. Captains rates are $30/hr and can be paid via zelle, venmo, or cash.
